title: Vitryne format v1: manifest.json
description: The first part a reader opens: what kind of file this is, which format version, and every part in it.

kind.description: project (.vtry): garments + avatar + fabrics + appearances + settings. garment (.vtryg): one garment and the fabrics and appearances it uses. fabric (.vtryf): one or more fabrics (a library). avatar (.vtrya): one avatar.

formatVersion.description: The format version this file was written in.

minReaderVersion.description: The oldest reader version that understands this file well enough to open and save it. Readers older than this refuse it (they may offer read-only viewing).

generator.description: What wrote the file, e.g. "vitryne 0.3.1 (web)". For diagnostics only.

parts.description: Every file in the container except mimetype and manifest.json.

extensionsUsed.description: Every extension name used anywhere in the file.

extensionsRequired.description: Extensions without which the file can't be used correctly. A reader that doesn't know one of these refuses the file.

path.description: Relative path in the container, '/' separated, no '..' segments, case-sensitive.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the part's bytes. Writers set it; readers warn (not fail) on a mismatch, so hand-edited files still open.

role.description: cache: derived data, safe to delete (see file-format.md, Simulation cache). source: an imported original, kept for reference. Absent: a regular part.
